+from jinja2 import nodes
+from jinja2.visitor import NodeTransformer
+from jinja2.visitor import NodeVisitor
+
+
+def test_nearest_node_family_handler():
+    class FamilyVisitor(NodeVisitor):
+        def visit_Node(self, node):
+            return ("node", type(node).__name__)
+
+        def visit_Expr(self, node):
+            return ("expr", type(node).__name__)
+
+    visitor = FamilyVisitor()
+    assert visitor.visit(nodes.Const(1)) == ("expr", "Const")
+    assert visitor.visit(nodes.Add(nodes.Const(1), nodes.Const(2))) == ("expr", "Add")
+    assert visitor.visit(nodes.Output([])) == ("node", "Output")
+
+
+def test_specific_and_inherited_visitor_handlers():
+    class Parent(NodeVisitor):
+        def visit_Expr(self, node):
+            return "expr"
+
+        def visit_Const(self, node):
+            return "const"
+
+    class Child(Parent):
+        pass
+
+    assert Child().visit(nodes.Const(1)) == "const"
+
+
+def test_custom_dispatch_remains_authoritative():
+    class Custom(NodeVisitor):
+        def get_visitor(self, node):
+            return lambda current: "custom"
+
+        def visit_Const(self, node):
+            return "specific"
+
+    assert Custom().visit(nodes.Const(1)) == "custom"
+
+
+def test_transformer_family_replacement():
+    class Rewrite(NodeTransformer):
+        def visit_Expr(self, node):
+            return nodes.Const(9)
+
+    tree = nodes.Output([nodes.Add(nodes.Const(1), nodes.Const(2))])
+    assert Rewrite().visit(tree) is tree
+    assert len(tree.nodes) == 1
+    assert isinstance(tree.nodes[0], nodes.Const)
+    assert tree.nodes[0].value == 9
+
+
+def test_default_generic_traversal_is_unchanged():
+    class Record(NodeVisitor):
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.names = []
+
+        def visit_Name(self, node):
+            self.names.append(node.name)
+
+    visitor = Record()
+    visitor.visit(nodes.Output([nodes.Name("x", "load")]))
+    assert visitor.names == ["x"]
spec.notes: The acceptance tests use existing node classes; they do not require defining new AST node types.
spec.question: Allow AST visitors to handle node families without defining a method for every concrete node type. The default `NodeVisitor.get_visitor` should look for `visit_<ClassName>` handlers along the node type's Python MRO, from the concrete class through `Node`, stopping before object, and return the first available handler. Thus `visit_Expr` can handle an expression when there is no more-specific handler, while `visit_Node` is the final family fallback. If no handler exists, retain the existing generic traversal. Visitor methods inherited by the visitor itself must still work, and subclasses overriding `get_visitor` must remain authoritative. This dispatch must also work for `NodeTransformer` without changing its replacement semantics. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
